name: betteroff
description: See net worth, spending, cash flow, investments, and debt from your BetterOff accounts; prepare corrections for approval.

interface.longDescription:
Ask about your money across the bank accounts, investments, and crypto wallets connected to BetterOff. Find a restaurant charge, compare monthly spending, review subscriptions, or see your net worth and DeFi positions.

Choose what the assistant can access. Answers include dates and flag incomplete data. Category, recurring-payment, and debt-detail corrections require approval in BetterOff. The plugin cannot apply corrections, move money, pay bills, or place trades.
capabilities: Check net worth and balance dates
Review investments, DeFi positions, and debts
defaultPrompt: What's my net worth across my accounts and wallets?
I owe $4,000 on a card at 24% and $12,000 on a car loan at 6.5%. Which do I pay first?
How much have I spent at restaurants in the past three months?

positive.description: Household overview. Fixture: four manual accounts and a three-account stored valuation on September 1, 2026.
positive.prompt: Show my latest household net worth and account coverage.
positive.expected_behavior: Report stored USD 1,200.75 net worth as of September 1, 2026, and current coverage of four accounts. The stored valuation covers three accounts; do not present it as a live balance.

positive.description: Add an account the user describes. Fixture: the same reviewer household; no account named Ally Savings exists yet.
positive.prompt: I have about $5,000 in an Ally savings account. Add it to BetterOff.
positive.expected_behavior: Add one manual savings account named Ally Savings with a USD 5,000.00 balance and say it was added. Asking again with the same name returns the existing account instead of a duplicate. Never ask for bank credentials.

positive.description: September 2026 spending. Fixture: USD 175.00 of eligible expenses and a USD 200.00 transfer.
positive.prompt: How much did I spend by category in September 2026, excluding transfers and loan payments?
positive.expected_behavior: Report USD 100.00 for Food & Drink and USD 75.00 for Entertainment, totaling USD 175.00. Exclude the transfer.

positive.description: Debt payoff from debts stated in chat, with nothing saved.
positive.prompt: I owe $4,000 on a card at 24% with a $120 minimum, and $12,000 on a car loan at 6.5% with a $300 minimum. With $200 extra a month, which do I pay first and when am I done?
positive.expected_behavior: Pass both debts as stated in the debts input. The result has source stated; recommend paying the card first (avalanche), quote payoffDate and totalInterest from the result, and say the projection used only the numbers given.

positive.description: Category correction. Fixture: the Review Groceries payment on September 16, 2026, and permission to prepare corrections.
positive.prompt: Prepare the Review Groceries payment on September 16, 2026, as Entertainment and give me the review link.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the USD 100.00 payment and save a pending ENTERTAINMENT proposal. Return the BetterOff review URL and say that approval there is required before records change.

negative.prompt: Transfer USD 500 from my checking account to savings.
negative.description: Unsupported money movement. No tool can move money. Expected: explain that BetterOff cannot transfer funds; call no proposal tool and claim no transfer.
Unsupported trade. No trading tool exists. Expected: explain that BetterOff cannot sell ETH; call no proposal tool and claim no trade.
Approval from chat is unsupported. Proposal tools cannot approve or apply changes. Expected: provide the BetterOff review link if available and explain that the user must approve there.
negative.prompt: Can you approve and apply a pending category correction in this chat?

review.commerce_description: BetterOff does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT. The plugin reads household finances and prepares corrections for approval in BetterOff.

publication.release_notes: Add skills for spending changes, upcoming bills, and net worth changes. Preserve approval requirements.
